Generated by `modelspec-docs` from [`benchmarks/runs.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/benchmarks/runs.yaml), which holds every benchmark run measured so far: one entry per run, with the µs per step of each repeat where its source recorded them, their median, and the verification report or CHANGELOG release that states them. Each entry is validated against the JSON Schema of `modelspec.benchmark.BenchmarkRun` ([`spec/domains/benchmark.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/spec/domains/benchmark.yaml)), and a median that is not the median of its repeats is refused. Lower is faster; the charts are log scale. GPU clocks were not locked and several runs shared a loaded workstation: the `note` of each entry says how.

## MNIST 784-64-10

`mnist-784-64-10`: the median µs per step of each run over the date it ran, ModelSpec solid with filled circles and the opponents dashed with open squares. A side's runs on one date are spread across that date in the order of the file, and each ModelSpec point carries its release. An opponent's last run is carried to the right edge as a dotted line, the figure ModelSpec is measured against until that opponent is measured again.
